business_summary: Advanced Biomed Inc., an investment holding company, engages in the research and development of microfluidic biochip technologies for precision oncology detection, diagnosis, and treatment in Taiwan. Its devices include A+Pre, an automated sample preparation system that enables pre-concentration of diluted blood samples; AC-1000, a rare cell device to solve the problem of detection of hypercoagulable state samples of tumor patients; A+SCDrop, a circulating tumor cell (CTC) single-cell capture device; and A+CellScan, an analyzer with an immunostaining chip for immunostaining/analysis of the AC-1000 product. The company also offers microfluidic biochips, such as A+Pre, AC-1000 CTC enrichment, and A+CellScan chips to provide assay products and services to cancer patients. In addition, its immunochromogenic kits include A+CTCE kit to identify epithelial circulating tumor cells and determined by the immunochromogenicity of EpCAM, CK (pan), CD45, and CD14 antibodies; A+CTCM kit to identify mesenchymal circulating tumor cells based on the immunochromogenicity of Vimentin, CD45, and CD14 antibodies; A+EMT to identify epithelial-to-mesenchymal circulating tumor cells determined by the immunochromogenicity of cell-surface Vimentin, and CD45 and CD14 antibodies; and A+CM to identify tumor-associated macrophages based on the immunochromogenicity of PD-L1, CD45, and CD14 antibodies. Further, the company is developing A+LCGuard for early screening of lung cancer. Additionally, it establishes and operates medical clinics in the People's Republic of China. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Advanced Biomed Inc.는 대만에서 정밀 종양학 검출, 진단 및 치료를 위한 미세유체 바이오칩 기술의 연구 개발에 참여하고 있습니다. 해당 장치에는 희석된 혈액 샘플을 사전 농축할 수 있는 자동화된 샘플 준비 시스템인 A+Pre가 포함됩니다. 종양 환자의 응고항진 상태 샘플 검출 문제를 해결하기 위한 희귀 세포 장치인 AC-1000; 순환 종양 세포(CTC) 단일 세포 포획 장치인 A+SCDrop; AC-1000 제품의 면역염색/분석을 위한 면역염색 칩을 탑재한 분석기인 A+CellScan이 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 A+Pre, AC-1000 CTC 농축, A+CellScan 칩과 같은 미세유체 바이오칩을 제공하여 암 환자에게 분석 제품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한, 면역발색성 키트에는 상피 순환 종양 세포를 식별하고 EpCAM, CK(pan), CD45 및 CD14 항체의 면역발색성에 의해 결정되는 A+CTCE 키트가 포함됩니다. Vimentin, CD45 및 CD14 항체의 면역색소성을 기반으로 중간엽 순환 종양 세포를 식별하기 위한 A+CTCM 키트; 면역에 의해 결정된 상피-중간엽 순환 종양 세포를 확인하기 위한 A+EMT
